title: Gen Z is leading old-school hobbies
claim: Context: young adults are adopting 'granny hobbies' (puzzles, crochet, mahjong), the base the hobbymaxxing trend builds on.
excerpt: 18-34-year-olds are now the most likely group to do a jigsaw puzzle on a monthly basis, and 73% of crocheters are 18-34-year-olds.
